name: Climb out of Hell
storyline:
You are a soul with no knowledge of the past, awakening at the bottom of a strange hell.

In this hell, not only human souls wander, spirits have names, bizarre creatures have cultures, and the echoes of your lost memories call you forward on a fantastic journey.

Your path to the paradise begins in the scalding pits that will test your initial skills. Then, it will lead you through a Dark Forest, a monochromatic world haunted by your own past, and finally, to a Frozen Kingdom where a silent ruler awaits.

To ascend, you must defeat the three children of the guardian of Paradise. No one has ever succeeded. It is said that only those who master their own pain and fear are worthy of redemption.

Can you Climb out of Hell?
summary: Accompany a soul seeking its origins through an uncanny atmosphere. Uncover the lost memories of your past, meet bizarrely endearing characters, and rise from the three circles of hell, all part of a bittersweet enigmatic journey.
